ctx.x: You just remembered your uncle's name, I think, right?
Yeah. Benjamin Young. And he got to be

great friends with James Petrillo because Petrillo was the President of the Federation at that time. And that was just before the recording strike, and my uncle kept warning me to watch out for it, because Petrillo didn't like the recorded music that was featured in the -- oh, I think in the lounge, you know.
